title: If you use ai in your steam capsule, you are basically telling players “please don’t play this game”
author: MarionberryReal2604
selftext: I don’t care how much you use ai in the game itself, just don’t use ai in the steam page art / capsule cause it genuinely looks like digital cancer, it damages your game reputation and damages every other dev that uses ai in their game, because now everytime a dev says “I used ai in my game” the only thing people would visualise are those cancerous ai capsules that scream “this is a cash grab made by Claude in 5 minutes, please continue scrolling”

comments.author: mallcopsarebastards
comments.body:
at this stage the models have become good enough that you cannot detect AI art by looking at it unless A) the person who generated it didn't put enough effort into it or B) the model you're using watermarked it.

There are a lot of slop capsules out there, for sure, but that's 100% a skill issue at this point. If you are using the proper tooling and making an effort nobody is going to know that your capsule art was made wiht AI. The fact that so many are obvious is because too many people think using AI means you can get away with cutting all the corners. If that's your approach you're just making slop anyway.

comments.author: Radiant-Mountain-257
comments.body: This is a really stupid take. You probably mean low effort capsules using AI model's native style, but if you prompt it well, describe the style you want, iterate and do some edits, you can end up with any style on a capsule. This is a general issue with doing anything low effort with or without AI.
